rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the group including the speaker, whether reflexive or emphatic.

example.traditional: 個蛋糕係我哋自己整嘅。
example.jyutping: go3 daan6 gou1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 zi6 gei2 zing2 ge3

rows.note: Use this when speaking directly to a group and referring back to everyone being addressed.

example.english: You yourselves decide; we’ll handle it ourselves.
example.traditional: 你哋自己決定，我哋自己搞掂啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 zi6 gei2 kyut3 ding6 ngo5 dei6 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6 laa1

rows.note: Use this with 我哋 as the subject when stressing that the group personally carried out the action rather than someone else.

example.english: We will handle the event ourselves this time.
example.traditional: 今次個活動我哋親自搞掂。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 wut6 dung6 ngo5 dei6 can1 zi6 gaau2 dim6
